product_updates.title: Anthropic is working on a system to prove AI models’ identity
product_updates.content: Called FlashProve, the system would let anyone check that an AI response really came from the model it claims to be from.

product_updates.title: Data centers are turning to old jet engines as the wait for power grows
product_updates.content: The years-long wait for access to the grid and new turbines is causing data center builders to turn to an unusual, less-efficient and less environmentally friendly solution: once-discarded jet engines.

product_updates.title: Ted Schlein’s Ballistic Ventures seeks $490M for new funds amid AI-driven cybersecurity boom
product_updates.content: Cybersecurity-focused Ballistic Ventures is seeking to raise $360 million for a new flagship fund and another $130 million for a separate investment vehicle.

product_updates.title: Hiding inside Palantir’s skyrocketing quarter is a foreboding signal
product_updates.content: Palantir's U.S. commercial revenue surpassed U.S. government revenue for the first time ever.

product_updates.title: AI inference startup Fal doubles its valuation to $16B as demand surges
product_updates.content: The five-year-old startup raised a $1.3 billion round led by Bessemer.

product_updates.title: Netflix’s new AI Discover tab helps you find something to watch based on your mood
product_updates.content: The first experimental feature under the tab will allow users to get recommendations based on what they're currently in the mood for.

product_updates.title: Anthropic is still grappling with the economics of compute
product_updates.content: At a moment when Anthropic's compute margins should be getting better, they’re getting worse.

product_updates.title: Google will let schools disable its AI tools, but not without sacrificing Search
product_updates.content: Schools choosing to restrict AI altogether will no longer be able to access Google Search, as AI features are now integrated into the search engine.

product_updates.title: Apple restricts dating apps and AI companions to users 18 and up
product_updates.content: Apple's new App Store rules will require 18+ ratings for dating apps and AI companions that offer sexual or romantic content.

product_updates.title: The TechCrunch Founder Summit agenda is only half the reason to be in Boston on November 4
product_updates.content: On November 4, TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 brings founders and VCs to Boston's SoWa Power Station for practical insights and connections. Register before prices increase at the door.
